title: rigor: architectural unit test
description: Implement a build-time test that inspects the module tree and asserts a maximum directory depth of 3.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL enforce structural module limits.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL fail if any module path depth > 3.

unwanted.condition: IF a deep hierarchy is introduced
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the build to pass

invariants: The test itself must not be deeper than the limit

title: rigor: dependency linter for lattice
description: Implement a test that forbids src/lattice from importing from src/intent or src/app.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain lattice as a pure, dependency-free engine.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL verify zero imports of intent/ or app/.

unwanted.condition: IF a cyclic or illegal dependency is added
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the commit

invariants: Domain imports ARE allowed in lattice

title: rigor: zero-panic linter enforcement
description: Ensure clippy::unwrap_used and clippy::expect_used are denied across all core and domain modules.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL follow a zero-panic architecture.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL fail on any unwrap or expect call.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT reach production

postconditions: Lints are applied to domain/, lattice/, and intent/
invariants: Errors MUST use Result variants instead of panics

phase_0: Update file headers with lint denials

title: rigor: mutation testing for quality engine
description: Run cargo-mutants on the unified quality module to verify test suite effectiveness. Goal: zero missed mutants.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL verify test rigor via mutation testing.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL catch 100% of arithmetic mutants in quality scoring.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT consider the test suite complete

postconditions: Mutation report shows 0 survivors in domain/quality.rs
invariants: The score math is tested against sign-flips and boundary shifts

phase_1: Add specific tests for boundary mutants

title: rigor: cue schema round-trip validation
description: Perform property-based testing of domain types against CUE schema definitions using proptest.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain 100% alignment between CUE schemas and Rust types.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL pass 'cue vet' against its schema.

unwanted.condition: IF the schema and code diverge
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow deployment
unwanted.because: schema skew is a catastrophic failure mode.

postconditions: Rust types match CUE constraints exactly
invariants: Serialized JSON is always valid CUE
